archetype_description: Pastel & Soft but with Neo-Brutalist contrast. Optimistic, light, tactile with hard black borders and bold typography to make it conversion-focused for customer attraction.

fonts.install_command: Use Google Fonts for Outfit and Work Sans

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF5722] text-white border-2 border-slate-900 rounded-xl px-8 py-4 font-bold text-lg hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-900 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all

cards.default: bg-white border-2 border-slate-900 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)]

mobile_qr_page.review_box: bg-white border-2 border-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-6 mx-4 my-6 text-xl leading-relaxed shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)] relative
mobile_qr_page.sticky_bottom_cta: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 bg-[#FDFBF7]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-t-2 border-slate-900 flex flex-col gap-3 z-50

navigation.header: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b-2 border-slate-900 px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center

hero.description: 3D glowing QR code floating over a cafe table. Use for the admin landing page hero section.
Abstract gold stars on pastel background. Use as a subtle header background for the mobile QR scan page.

icons.instruction: Use Lucide-react icons heavily. Stroke-width 2.5 for a punchy, neo-brutalist feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing and mobile UI. Use Shadcn + Tailwind for Admin Dashboard but override borders and shadows to match the neo-brutalist theme (2px borders, 4px solid shadow).

For the QR scan landing page: DO NOT use a standard center-aligned generic page. Use the 'mobile_qr_page' layout instructions. The AI review must be in a massive, highly legible card. The 'Copy & Post on Google' CTA MUST be sticky at the bottom of the viewport so the user doesn't have to scroll to find it.
Implement a micro-interaction on the 'Copy' button: When clicked, change text to 'Copied!' and button color to success.default (#A7F3D0), then open the Google Business link in a new tab.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and form inputs (e.g., data-testid='copy-review-btn').
For QR Code generation in the admin panel, use a library like 'qrcode.react' and ensure the QR code is displayed inside a styled neo-brutalist card that the admin can download or print.
Fonts must be imported from Google Fonts: 'Outfit' (wght: 400..900) for Headings, 'Work Sans' (wght: 400..700) for Body.
Do NOT use 'Inter'. Ensure it is fully removed from Tailwind config default sans.
